name: list_contract_commitments
description:
Retrieve a Vercel team's commitment allocations per contract period (FOCUS v1.3). Applies only to Enterprise customers; Pro and Flex teams get an empty result. Large results are returned as a bounded sample of the first and last records.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/billing/contract-commitments --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
